tools.name: list_frontend_design_skill_files
tools.title: List Frontend Design Skill Files
tools.description: List the files in the platform 'frontend-design' skill, the platform's guidance for making a website, web app, or mobile UI look intentionally designed rather than AI-generated or templated. Call this whenever you are building, generating, restyling, or reviewing user-facing UI - choosing fonts, colors, layout, components, imagery, icons, copy, or motion, or checking responsive and mobile behavior. Covers the universal anti-tells (default fonts like Inter/Geist, indigo and purple-blue gradients, cream backgrounds, low-contrast grey body text, pill/eyebrow heroes, icon-card grids, shadcn-default cards, em-dashes, fade-up-everything, model-generated icons, inconsistent components, missing mobile menus), a sample style direction, and a self-check. Returns each file with its path, name, and description so you can read only what you need; start with SKILL.md.

project.title: project
project.description: The frontend-design skill (frontend-design). Always this value.

tools.name: read_frontend_design_skill_file
tools.title: Read Frontend Design Skill File
tools.description: Read one file from the platform 'frontend-design' skill in full, for designing or reviewing user-facing UI. Pass filePath exactly as list_frontend_design_skill_files reports it. SKILL.md is the main guide: the distilled universal anti-tells for type, color, layout, components, imagery, copy, motion, consistency, and responsive/mobile behavior, the Editorial Bold sample style direction, and a self-check to run before calling UI done. TELLS.md is the full catalog of roughly 100 tells across 9 categories, each with a fix.

project.title: project
project.description: The frontend-design skill (frontend-design). Always this value.

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Path of the file to read, relative to the skill folder, as reported by list_frontend_design_skill_files. Use 'SKILL.md' for the main guide or 'TELLS.md' for the full catalog.
